id: title:Gilbert09:sync the ads table past an ad with an invalid advantage creative

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for Meta Ads Advantage+ creative refusal recovery, including schema fields, parameter overrides, and pagination state preservation.
review.reason: Adds a schema field and retrieval, a URL parameter override helper, and pagination state preservation to support Meta Ads Advantage+ creative refusal and recovery. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion.
review.uncertainty: No test implementation changes are supplied, and no tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No cross-PR or cross-repo context is supplied, so no relationship or shared-risk assessment is possible. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds a schema field and its retrieval, and a new helper to override query parameters, and a new error subcode and its detection, and a new multi-id lookup and field restoration, and a new pagination and request-issuing path, and a new paginated request entry point, and a new row retrieval. All are added to support Meta Ads Advantage+ creative refusal and recovery.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a schema field to record which fields Meta may refuse for a single ad, and its retrieval, so the ingestion can request a reduced field set and restore missing fields per row.

observations.behavior: Adds retrieval of the refusable_fields parameter from the schema definition.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion to read the configured refusable fields from the schema and pass them downstream.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to override a query parameter in a URL, and refactors the existing limit-override helper to use it.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared URL-query-parameter override utility, used later to switch the request fields when Meta refuses a page.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test code. No implementation changes are supplied, so no score can be assigned. No score.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and three test methods, including a new exception and a new 400 response, and an assertion on the saved state.
observations.code_quote: assert saved.next_url is not None and "fields=id%2Cname%2Ccreative" in saved.next_url
observations.posthog_connection: Checks pagination state and parameter preservation after a refusal, but this is not an implementation change.
